pages.description: RCF Online Academy: six-month preparatory courses for the CALSDA elocution diplomas, and English Literature courses from Grade 9 to Advanced Level, conducted online by R. C. Fernando.
pages.keywords: RCF Online Academy, CALSDA elocution diploma, Primary Elocution Teachers Diploma, Associate Diploma, Grade 9 Literature, Grade 10 Literature, O/L Literature, A/L Literature, online classes Sri Lanka

hero.text: Six courses, taught online by R. C. Fernando: two professional preparatory courses for the CALSDA elocution diploma examinations, and four English Literature courses from Grade 9 to Advanced Level.

blocks.heading: About the Academy
text: RCF Online Academy is the teaching arm of RCF English. Courses are conducted online, which allows students anywhere in the country to attend rather than only those within reach of one town.

All courses are taught by **R. C. Fernando**, a graduate in English of the University of Peradeniya, holder of a Master of Arts in Linguistics from the University of Kelaniya and a TESOL qualification from the University of Peradeniya, and an Associate Member of the Colombo Association of Language Skills and Dramatic Art (CALSDA). [More about our staff](rcf-classes/our-staff/).

blocks.heading: Elocution diplomas
intro: Two six-month courses preparing candidates for the diploma examinations of the Colombo Association of Language Skills and Dramatic Art (CALSDA).

items.title: Primary Elocution Teachers' Diploma
text: A six-month professional preparatory course for candidates sitting the CALSDA Primary Elocution Teachers' Diploma examination.

items.title: Associate Diploma
text: The higher elocution diploma. A six-month professional preparatory course for candidates sitting the CALSDA Associate Diploma examination.

blocks.title: About the diplomas, stated plainly
bullets: The elocution diplomas are **set, examined and awarded by CALSDA** — the Colombo Association of Language Skills and Dramatic Art.
**RCF Online Academy conducts preparatory courses** for those examinations. It does not award the diplomas.
**RCF Online Academy is not an official representative, agent or branch of CALSDA**, and does not speak for it.
Entry requirements, syllabus, examination dates and CALSDA's own fees are matters for CALSDA, and candidates should confirm them with CALSDA directly.

blocks.heading: Literature courses
intro: Four courses following a student through school Literature, each taught the same way: read the text whole, study it closely, then practise answers and have them corrected individually.

items.title: Grade 9 Literature
text: The habits that make Ordinary Level straightforward: reading closely, finding evidence, explaining an effect.

items.title: Grade 10 Literature
text: The first year of the Ordinary Level course, at a pace that allows the texts to be studied properly.

items.title: O/L Literature
text: Examination year: texts completed, answers written to time, every piece corrected.

items.title: A/L Literature
text: Close reading, critical appreciation of unseen passages, and well-organised essay answers.

blocks.heading: How the courses are taught
intro: Deliberately gradual, because most students fail at written answers and at prepared speech through lack of preparation rather than lack of ability.

items.title: Clear and systematic explanation
text: One point at a time, in plain language, with the reason behind it and not only the rule.

items.title: Guided practice before independent work
text: Nothing is set cold. A model is studied, the structure identified, and support withdrawn step by step.

items.title: Individual correction and feedback
text: Written and spoken work is corrected individually, with one clear instruction rather than a page of red.

items.title: Examination preparation where relevant
text: Paper structure, timing, answer development and past-paper practice for those preparing for an examination.

items.title: Regular revision
text: Deliberate return to earlier work, spaced out, because that is what makes learning permanent.

items.title: Confidence, and support for those in difficulty
text: Extra help for students who are struggling, without singling them out in front of others.

pages.title: Registration
pages.description: How to register for a course at RCF Online Academy: choose a course, send the message the form writes for you, and receive schedule, fee and availability information.
pages.keywords: registration, register, enrol, RCF Online Academy, elocution diploma, literature course

hero.text: Registration is a short conversation, not a form that disappears into a system. Nothing on this website registers you; a place is confirmed by the teacher.

items.title: Choose a course
text: The six courses are listed on the [Academy overview](rcf-classes/). If you are unsure which suits you, choose *Not sure, please advise* below and say what you have already done.

items.title: Send the message
text: Fill in the form below and it writes your message for you, then opens WhatsApp. Read it, then press send yourself.

items.title: Receive schedule, fee and availability information
text: You will be told the current day and time, the fee, and whether places are available. This is given directly rather than published, because it changes.

items.title: Confirm registration
text: If the course suits you, confirm. **Registration is confirmed by the teacher.** It is not automatic, and no place is reserved by visiting this website.

items.title: Receive joining instructions
text: Once your place is confirmed, joining details are sent to you privately. They are never published on this website.

blocks.title: How this form works
bullets: This website has **no server**, so nothing is submitted anywhere. The form writes your message and opens WhatsApp, where **you** press send.
Nothing you type is stored on this website or seen by anyone until you send it yourself.
If you would rather not use the form, the same information sent as an ordinary WhatsApp message is perfectly fine.

blocks.title: Please note
bullets: **Nothing on this website constitutes an offer of a place.** Course information here is descriptive.
**No payment is taken on this website.** Never enter payment or card details anywhere on this site. Fee arrangements are discussed directly.
**Do not send** identity documents, index numbers or anything confidential in an enquiry.
For the two elocution diplomas, entering the CALSDA examination itself is arranged by the candidate with CALSDA. Registering for the preparatory course does not enter you for the examination.

items.q: Can I register on this website?
a: No. This website has no server and no registration system. Registration is arranged directly with the teacher on WhatsApp, and a place is confirmed only by the teacher.

items.q: Is any payment taken here?
a: No. RCF English does not take payments of any kind, and no payment details should ever be entered anywhere on this site.

items.q: Does registering for an elocution course enter me for the CALSDA examination?
a: No. The course prepares you for the examination. Entering the examination itself is arranged by you with CALSDA, and their entry requirements and dates are matters for them.

items.q: Can I join after a course has started?
a: It depends on the course and how far it has progressed. The two elocution courses run for six months as a sequence, so joining late is more difficult. Ask, and you will be told honestly whether it would work for you.

items.q: Can my parent register for me?
a: Of course. Please say who the student is, their grade or level, and what they need help with.

items.q: How soon will I get a reply?
a: Messages are answered as soon as possible. If you have not heard within a couple of days, please send a reminder - messages are occasionally missed.

hero.text: All courses at the Academy are currently taught by its founder. Who teaches you is not left vague.

blocks.heading: R. C. Fernando
text: R. C. Fernando is an experienced English teacher and lecturer who has devoted several decades to English-language learning and teaching. He founded RCF English and teaches all six courses at RCF Online Academy.

His work extends beyond classroom teaching to teacher support, online learning communities, educational publishing and the preparation of practical learning materials. [More about the founder](about/founder/).

parts.heading: The elocution diploma courses
text: Associate Membership of CALSDA reflects a professional connection with the association whose examinations these courses prepare candidates for. It is a membership, not an office: it does not make the Academy a representative of CALSDA, and the diplomas are awarded by CALSDA alone.

parts.heading: The Literature courses
text: A degree in English supports the reading of poetry, drama and fiction, and the close attention to a text that a good Literature answer needs.

parts.heading: Every course
text: Advanced study in linguistics supports an understanding of how English actually works rather than a list of rules; TESOL training supports teaching English to learners for whom it is not a first language; and several decades in classrooms supply what qualifications alone cannot — knowledge of where learners actually go wrong, and of what genuinely helps them.

blocks.title: A note on this page
text: Only qualifications actually held are listed. RCF English does not claim any qualification, award, appointment or approval that it does not hold, and makes no claim of government endorsement or official status of any kind.
At present the Academy has one teacher. If further teachers join, they will be named on this page with their own qualifications. This page will not list anyone who is not actually teaching.

pages.title: Questions
pages.description: Answers to common questions about RCF Online Academy: the courses, the CALSDA elocution diplomas, registering, schedules and fees, and what is needed to attend.
pages.keywords: questions, FAQ, RCF Online Academy, CALSDA, registration, fees

hero.text: If your question is not answered here, ask on WhatsApp - the answer is usually quicker than the search.

items.q: Does RCF Online Academy award the elocution diplomas?
a: No. The Primary Elocution Teachers' Diploma and the Associate Diploma are set, examined and awarded by CALSDA, the Colombo Association of Language Skills and Dramatic Art. RCF Online Academy conducts preparatory courses for those examinations.

items.q: Is RCF Online Academy an official representative of CALSDA?
a: No. It is not a representative, agent or branch of CALSDA and does not speak for it. Its founder is an Associate Member of CALSDA, which is a membership and not an office.

items.q: How long are the courses?
a: Both elocution courses run for six months.

items.q: Does the course enter me for the CALSDA examination?
a: No. The course prepares you for the examination. Entering it is arranged by you with CALSDA.

items.q: What are the entry requirements?
a: Entry requirements for the examinations are set by CALSDA, and candidates should confirm them with CALSDA directly. This website does not state them, because they are not ours to state.

items.q: Which of the two courses should I take?
a: Say what you have already done and you will be advised honestly. Being pointed at the right course matters more than filling a place in the wrong one.

items.q: Which grades are covered?
a: Grade 9, Grade 10, Ordinary Level and Advanced Level.

items.q: Do I need my own copies of the prescribed texts?
a: Yes. Copyrighted literary texts are not reproduced on this website or supplied with a course.

items.q: Is written work corrected?
a: Yes. Individual correction of written work is one of the main emphases of every course.

items.q: Why start Literature in Grade 9?
a: Most students who struggle at Ordinary Level are not short of ability; they arrive having read texts but never having been shown how an answer is built. A year spent on those habits first makes the two that follow much easier.

items.q: How do I register?
a: Choose a course, then use the [registration page](rcf-classes/registration/) or a WhatsApp button. You will be sent the schedule, fee and availability information. Registration is confirmed by the teacher; it is not automatic.

items.q: Why are the days, times and fees not published?
a: Because they change, and an out-of-date timetable helps nobody. Times are also sometimes arranged around the students who want a particular course. Where nothing has been settled, this site says so rather than inventing a schedule.

items.q: Is any payment taken on this website?
a: No. RCF English does not take payments of any kind. Never enter payment details anywhere on this site.

items.q: Can I join in the middle of a course?
a: It depends on the course and how far it has gone. The elocution courses run as a six-month sequence, so joining late is more difficult. Ask, and you will be told honestly.

items.q: Are the courses online?
a: Yes. All courses are conducted online, which allows students anywhere in the country to attend.

items.q: What do I need in order to attend?
a: A device with an internet connection, a notebook and a pen. The elocution courses also need a working microphone, since the work is spoken. Literature courses need the prescribed texts.

items.q: What if my internet connection is weak?
a: Mention it when you enquire. It is a common situation and better discussed in advance than discovered in the first class.

items.q: Will I be sent a meeting link?
a: Joining instructions are sent privately once your place is confirmed. Links and passwords are never published on this website.

items.q: Can examination results be guaranteed?
a: No, and nobody honest will guarantee them. Results depend on the candidate's own work. What the courses provide is clear teaching, guided practice, individual correction and regular revision.

items.q: Who teaches the courses?
a: All six courses are taught by R. C. Fernando. His qualifications are set out on the [Our Staff](rcf-classes/our-staff/) page.
